name: MotionKit
message: 55 new editor templates (render bars, error dialogs, drag & drop, effect search ...) + an update checker so you never miss a new version.
how: Open your Gumroad library, download the new MotionKit zip, close After Effects / Premiere Pro and run the installer again. Your settings and license stay.

changes.text: 28 editor timeline templates (Elements > Timeline): render bar green / red, render queue, trim in / out, split layer, drag file to timeline, pre-compose, pick whip, markers, time remap, audio waveform, expression error, missing footage, timecode, RAM preview loop and more

27 editor UI templates (Elements > UI Animation): error + warning dialogs, render complete, render progress, out of memory, missing fonts, drag & drop import, effect search typing, effect controls, color picker, export format, undo history, context menu and more
Update checker: MotionKit tells you when a new version is out (green Update button in the header + Settings > About > Updates)
"What's new" window after every update
243 money templates: Simple (32), Loops (31), Explosions (30), Paper Cut (30), Hand Drawn (30), Infographics (30), Timeline (30) and UI Animation (30)

Coins, bills, money bags, piggy banks, wallets, cards, price tags, gold, charts, KPI cards, payment success, checkout, wallet balance, transaction list and more - currency symbol is editable ($, ₹, €, ₿ ...)
Grid Transition + Split Screen: presets / templates open in a side drawer with adjustable thumbnail size
Cleaner settings: Grid / Animation / Timing and Panel / Layout / Style / Animation tabs
Corner and box reveal grid animations (from all 4 corners, rings, zip, blinds, shutter, snake, rain) + 21 Reveal presets
40 editor timeline templates: color wheels, curves, scopes, node graph, mobile editor strips, trim, keyframes, graph editor, audio mixer, multicam
Theme accent colors are perfect circles

history.title: Viral tab: Grid Transition + Split Screen

changes.text: Editor Mode > Viral: Grid Transition (12 styles, 15 patterns, 20 presets) for After Effects and Premiere Pro
Split Screen Studio: 36 layouts, borders, rounded corners, background, panel animations
AI Mode tabs use a compact layout; Captions & Voice keys in Settings > API Keys
Gradient lock now stays with the shape when it moves or scales
AI Mode > Create Image: aspect ratio, resolution, count, style and 7 image engines
Settings > API Keys: sections for Direct Chat, BG Remove, AI Enhancer and Create Image with auto-detect, show / hide and more than one key
Smoother, lighter panel (less CPU while idle)
60 transitions, animated cursors, Explosions / Arcs / Blow Ups packs
46 slider templates in Elements > Timeline: video / music players, story bars, progress bars, editor tracks, waveforms
Chat animation tab, FX Search palette, screen color picker
Timeline sliders, graph Value / Speed switch, Remove Silence closes gaps, multi-layer create, Repeater X / Y / Z, comp duplicate with copies
Panel freeze fix and gradient lock
AI Mode (BETA) for AE + PP: Direct Chat, BG Remove and AI Enhancer
New Elements > Timeline tab: timeline, progress and process animation templates
More Premiere Pro carousel templates
Faster loading, no more freezing; Social Media and Cards layout fixes
